description:
Request for Information (RFI) & Sources Sought Notice

Field Support Equipment Rental Services

Issued By:
906th Contracting Battalion
Daegu, Republic of Korea

Reference Number: W90VN926QDT1
Date of Issuance: 6 March 2026

Participation in this RFI is restricted to vendors located and operating within the Republic of Korea.

All sources may submit a quote or quote as applicable. However, the Republic of Korea (ROK)-United States (U.S.) Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA), precludes the U.S. Government from granting  Invited Contractor or Technical Representative status to any offeror, for this requirement. All sources  submitting a quote or quote, as applicable, including U.S. sources, must already have, or obtain the  requisite business licenses directly from the ROK Government, and conduct business in accordance with  all applicable ROK laws, including but not limited to, rules and policies regarding labor, taxation, and  immigration. Any contractor not already doing business in Korea as a local source, must submit adequate verification in its initial quote or quote, that it has the requisite authorization and capacity to compete  for the requirement as a local source, and to perform the contract as a local source. If an initial quote  does not fully demonstrate this authorization and capacity, it will not be further considered for award.  Whether an offeror qualifies as a local source shall be determined by the Contracting Officer.

The 906th Contracting Battalion is issuing this Sources Sought Notice as a Request for Information (RFI) to conduct market research. The objective is to identify and assess the capabilities of vendors ONLY of the Republic of Korea that can delivered, installed, and maintain field support equipment for a designated period.

Scope of Requirements

The Government requires the rental of the following equipment. The selected contractor will be responsible for the delivery, full installation, and ongoing maintenance of all items for the entire Period of Performance.

Delivery Location:
Rodriguez Live Fire Complex Main Gate, Pocheon, Republic of Korea

Period of Performance (PoP):
16 March 2026 – 10 April 2026

Required Equipment:

  • CLIN 0001: Industrial Washing Machine with dedicated Generator/ with Fuel (Quantity: 8 units)
  • CLIN 0002: Industrial Clothes Dryer with dedicated Generator// with Fuel (Quantity: 8 units)
  • CLIN 0003: Flood Light Tower with dedicated Generator// with Fuel (Quantity: 8 units)
  • CLIN 0004: 20-Foot Refrigerated Container with dedicated Generator/ with Fuel (Quantity: 1)

^^^^POP: 16 March 2026 – 10 April 2026 (25 days)

-Submission Instructions

Interested parties are requested to provide a capabilities statement demonstrating their ability to meet the requirements. Submissions should include:

  • Company Name, Address, and Point of Contact information.
  • Confirmation of ability to deliver, install, and maintain all listed equipment.
  • Relevant past performance information or experience.

Please submit responses via email to the contracting office no later than March 09, 2026 at 13;00 KST.
